english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a stated reason, justification, or explanation.
This is the all-purpose choice for a reason or justification, such as grounds for divorce.
Use 理由 for a justification or sufficient reason, including a reason for taking or avoiding an action.
Use this for a reason or statement offered to support a claim, rather than for a quarrel.
Use this when occasion means a reason or motive for a reaction or action.
